transcript:
# CITY OF WALTHAM

MASSACHUSETTS

BOARD OF HEALTH

MICHELLE M. FEELEY

DIRECTOR OF PUBLIC HEALTH

# Waltham Board of Health Minutes

## September 16, 2026

The Board of Health meeting was called to order at 5:01PM by Chairman Dr. Merola.

- Chairman Dr. Merola – Present
- Vice-Chairman Bernie Mullin – Present
- Member Mary Baker – Present
- Member Dr. Lerner – Present
- Member Dr. Patricia Sweder - Present

Chairman Dr. Merola asked for a motion to approve the minutes of the last meeting, June 17, 2026. Member Dr. Sweder made motion to approve, second motion by Member Baker. Minutes approved by all members.

**First item on the agenda** – Happy Feet - Owner came to meeting with Joshua, his representative. Per the BodyWork Regulations, someone needs to be able to speak English effectively. Appearance of owner and workers needs to improve. Motion was made by Dr. Sweder that the owner needs to submit a compliance plan to the Health Department before the Board of Health meeting in October, if plan is not received, Happy Feet will need to appear before the Board. Motion to approve by Member Baker, second motion by Member Dr. Lerner. Motion is approved by all members.

**Second item on the agenda** – Mass Health Officers Association (MHOA) – Discussion to have MHOA be the tobacco agent for Waltham for FY27 for compliance checks. Motion to approve by Member Dr. Lerner, second motion by Vice Chairman Mullin. Motion approved by all members.

Next meeting will be October 21, 2026, at 5PM. All Board members approved.

Motion to adjourn made by Vice-Chairman Mullin, second motion by Member Dr. Sweder, meeting adjourned at 6:00PM.
